push.label: Also push to this device
push.hintOn: This device is registered: what you chose below reaches it even with Claudio closed.
push.hintOff: Sends what you choose below to this device even when Claudio is closed. The browser will ask for permission.
push.failed: Could not change push notifications for this device
push.incomplete: This browser gave back a subscription with no encryption keys, so nothing could be sent to it.
push.noWorker: This browser has no service worker for Claudio yet, so there is nothing to deliver a notification to. Reload the page and try again.

blocked.insecure: This page comes from {{origin}}, which browsers do not treat as a secure origin, so there is no service worker here and no push either. Reach Claudio over https:// — or from localhost — and this switch comes back.
blocked.iosTab: On iPhone and iPad a notification only reaches an app added to the Home Screen, never a tab: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and turn this on from the app that starts.
blocked.unsupported: This browser cannot receive Web Push.
blocked.unconfigured: This server has no signing key for push, so nothing it sent could be delivered. Its log says why.
blocked.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser's own settings, and this switch comes back.

diff.binary: Binary file: there is no text to compare.
diff.tooLarge: This diff is too large to show.
diff.truncated: The diff is cut here: the rest is too long to show.
diff.unexplained: What {{agent}} wrote before this change does not explain it.
diff.fingerprint: Change fingerprint: each file as wide as what changed in it
diff.fingerprintMore: {{count}} more files, too small for a segment of their own: open the first

effort.unavailableModel: This model does not take an effort level.

row.label: Guards
row.help: Block dangerous commands and file writes in this graph's runs.
row.workflowHint: A workflow's subagents may not pass through the guard, so Claudio can refuse to launch it while guards are on. Switch guards off for this graph to run it anyway.

sheet.title: Guard rules
sheet.body: Switch off only what you must. What you leave as it is follows Settings.

integrity.name: Integrity
integrity.hint: Protects the guard itself, and blocks command lines it cannot read

no-verify.name: No skipping checks
no-verify.hint: Blocks --no-verify and settings that turn hooks off.

push.name: No pushing
push.hint: Blocks any write to a remote.

destructive.name: No destructive commands
destructive.hint: Blocks force pushes, reset --hard and rm -rf outside the worktree.

secrets.name: No secrets in files
secrets.hint: Blocks writing a secret to a file.

protect-configs.name: Protect configs
protect-configs.hint: Blocks edits to existing lint, format and CI configs.

guards.chipOpen: Open the chat at the first guard notice

popover.title: Guards on this chat
popover.armed: These rules check every tool call of this chat.
popover.observe: Observe mode: the guard records what it would block and blocks nothing.
popover.missing: A tool call went by without the guard, so the chat was interrupted.
